## Definition of done

- [ ] The behaviour is covered by tests (acceptance for flows, unit for rules)
- [ ] `composer check` is green
- [ ] Public code and non-obvious decisions are documented, with the specification section cited
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` is updated if a rule, a flow or the architecture changed
- [ ] A Management API change is in `docs/openapi/management-api.yaml`; a discovery change in `ProviderMetadata`
- [ ] A new table comes with its migration; a new setting with its `#[Range]` and documentation
